q: What do lenders usually ask for when an MSME borrows to buy electric vehicles?
title: EV fleet loans: what lenders ask
short: Expect vehicle quotations, registration plans, a charging plan and the business case. For green labelling, lenders want the use of proceeds tied to the vehicles and a way to report the result, usually kilometres run and diesel or petrol displaced.
audience: MSMEs electrifying delivery or passenger fleets

ul: Where and how vehicles will charge.
Current fuel bills for the vehicles being replaced.

p: Track kilometres and charging units each month. Comparing with the old fuel bills gives the emissions saved.

senseible: Senseible builds a bill-backed emissions record with the source on every line, the evidence a lender's credit team can check.

sources.label: Loan Market Association, Green Loan Principles (lma.eu.com)
